# WS-DRIFT-LVP RESULTS (generated by tools/analysis/make-results-md.mjs from results.json; arm64 containers on one host, 2 CPU / 2 GB slot per run)

Baseline = `noble-25.2.8` (Mesa 25.2.8 / LLVM 20.1.2, the Phase-2 pin), run `run2`. "bit change" = lane whose GPU result bits differ; split into value change (non-NaN or NaN vs non-NaN), NaN-payload-only, zero-sign-only. Category = frozen-evaluator CTS-interval class (accepted / indeterminate / rejected).
